newsitem.title: FRANCE: French magistrate probes Socialist Euro-MP.
newsitem.headline: French magistrate probes Socialist Euro-MP.

text.p: A magistrate has opened a probe into a French Socialist member of the European parliament on suspicion of fraud in a southern French town, judicial sources said on Saturday.
Jean-Francois Bernardini, head of the socialist federation of the southern Bouches-du-Rhone region, was targeted for his work as finance chief of the town hall of Istres.
Bernardini was targeted for misappropriation of public funds and fraud linked to a suspect 20 million franc ($3.4 million) payment to Istres soccer club.

Bernardini and Istres mayor Jacques Siffre, placed under investigation last week in the same case, both deny any wrongdoing. Four other people have been placed under investigation since 1995, including the head of Istres soccer club.
